text:
Marta (ML Eng): Quick async sync — meridian6b-open onboarding status. Need confirmations: licensing OK? perf profile uploaded? model manifest PR merged? Owners for rollout: curation=Jess, runtime=Ryan, infra=Sam.

Jess (Curation): License looks ok (Apache-2.0 with attribution). Manifest updated and sample prompts uploaded. :thumbsup:

Ryan (Runtime): Running perf sweep now. Saw a cold-start latency bump at seq=512, digging in. Uploaded perf artifact: s3://redwood-perf/meridian6b/profile-2026-03-17.json

Sam (Infra): Canary pool available but we need the runtime flag enabled on dedicated nodes: `--kv-cache-v2`. Left comment on PR #7842 asking for a toggle gate.

Marta (ML Eng): PR link for context: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/7842 — can someone take the final merge once checks pass?

Ryan (Runtime): Reviewing the PR now. I want to add a small sharding tweak (reduce per-shard memory footprint) and a recommended quantization profile (Q8_0). Pinging @Sam for infra capacity to support 4 shards per node.

Sam (Infra): I can allocate nodes but eu-west1 capacity is tight this week. I'll open an infra ticket and try to reserve for Monday slot.

Legal (Legal): Confirmed the license is compatible for hosting. Please add upstream authorship & attribution to the model card before public rollout.

Marta (ML Eng): Ryan — can you attach a latency breakdown and the smoke run results to the PR? Also include the eval set link.

Ryan (Runtime): Done — added latency table + CI smoke job. Kicked off smoke locally: `./run_smoke.sh meridian6b-open --tokens 128` — initial results look ok aside from the seq512 spike.

canary-bot: Canary schedule created for meridian6b-open — start=2026-03-19T02:00Z duration=48h target=10rps fallback-model=llama-mini

Jess (Curation): Quick QA pass — outputs are generally good, noticed some mild repetition on conversational prompts. Filed TICKET-1147 with examples.

Marta (ML Eng): Action list from this thread: 1) Merge PR after CR + attach perf docs (Ryan/Jess) 2) Infra allocate nodes + enable flag (Sam) 3) Add attribution to model card (Legal) 4) Monitor canary and escalate if error rate >1%. I'll follow up tomorrow morning. :eyes:

Ryan (Runtime): Will finish CR and merge after Sam confirms infra. ETA: Mon 12:00 UTC.

Sam (Infra): INF-3921 opened for node reservation: https://jira.redwood/INF-3921 — I'll post status here once nodes are ready.

Marta (ML Eng): Thanks all — marking this as our async checkpoint. Ping this thread if anything slips or you need handoffs.
